title: fix(plugin-charts): a sankey names its nodes and colours its flows, a funnel labels every stage, the sankey footnote is translated (objectui#13404)
body:
Closes #13404
Clause-②: no

## What changed

All three defects are in `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`.

1. **Sankey: node names and link colours.** `node` and `link` were plain objects, so Recharts drew bare rectangles with no text and every link was the same `muted-foreground` grey. There are now two module-scope renderers:
   - `SankeyNodeShape` draws the rect plus the node's name. The name goes to the right of the node, or to the left for a node with no outgoing link. Under `align: 'justify'` those are exactly the last-column nodes, which sit against the right edge.
   - `SankeyLinkShape` draws the same curve Recharts' default draws, stroked at opacity 0.4 in the colour of the node the link flows into.

   Each category node takes `palette[idx % palette.length]` through `resolveColor`, the same positional palette the funnel and treemap arms use, and it honours a caller's `colors`. The root keeps `muted-foreground` because it is the total, not a category. The renderers are at module scope because Recharts lists `node` and `link` in the dependencies of its layout memo. The `as any` on `node` is gone.
2. **Funnel: labels clipped.** `LabelList position="right"` put every label past its trapezoid's right edge. The widest stage's edge is the plot edge, so those labels drew off the surface. Labels are now `position="center"` with foreground text inside a background halo (`HALO_LABEL_PROPS`).
3. **Sankey footnote is English-only.** "Showing N of M rows ..." now comes from a new count family, `chart.sankeyOmittedRows` (base, `_one`, `_other`, plus each language's extra CLDR slots), translated in all ten packs. The English text is unchanged. The measure key is still drawn as a `code` chip: the sentence is interpolated with a private-use mark in `{{field}}` and split on it, the same construction as `withChips` in `metadata-viewer`, so each language decides where the chip goes.

## Judgment calls

- **Links take the TARGET's colour, not the source's.** The card asks for "the source node's palette colour", but in this arm every link leaves the same root node: `links = rows.map((r, i) => ({ source: 0, target: i + 1, ... }))`. Colouring by source would paint every link one colour again, which is the defect. The target is the category the link carries, so each link matches the node it ends in. For the same reason the test cannot build "two links with different sources", so it pins two flows into two categories carrying two different strokes, each equal to its node's fill.
- **Funnel labels inside the segments rather than a reserved right margin.** A centred label is anchored on the funnel's axis, the vertical line through the middle of the chart, so no stage name can be pushed off the surface. Reserving room on the right would shrink every funnel by its longest name and still clip a name longer than the reserve. A single contrasting fill fails on the narrowest stage: a white label disappears once it is wider than the segment and spills onto the background. The foreground-on-background halo reads on both the segment and the background, in light and dark themes (both colours are theme tokens). Recharts' centre position also wraps a multi-word name to the segment's mid-height width in a real browser.
- **`createSafeTranslation`, not the file's `useSafeTranslate`.** The sentence agrees with a count ("1 row has" / "2 rows have"), so it is an i18next count family and the call has to pass `count`, which `useSafeTranslate` cannot. Its defaults map is what a host without a provider renders, and it picks `_one` / `_other` the way i18next does. `check:i18n-keys` confirms each defaults row repeats the `en` pack value.

## Tests

New: `AdvancedChartImpl.sankeyFunnelLabels-13404.test.tsx` (13 tests, jsdom, asserting on rendered SVG text and attributes):

- Sankey: every node name is a `text` (root series label plus each category). The root's name is right of its node with `text-anchor` start. Each last-column name is left of its node with `text-anchor` end, inside the 480px surface. The three links carry three distinct strokes, equal to their target nodes' fills and to `--chart-1..3`. The root fill is not used by any link. A caller `colors` palette reaches the links.
- Funnel: one label per stage. Every label is anchored between 25% and 75% of the width, all on one x (the narrowest stage on the same axis as the widest), with `text-anchor` middle. The narrowest stage's label carries the foreground fill, background stroke and `paint-order` stroke.
- Footnote: en with no provider reads exactly the old text in the plural and the singular, with the key still in `code`. en under `I18nProvider` reads the same, which pins the defaults map to the en pack. zh renders the zh `_other` row with the counts filled in and the chip kept. Every pack carries the family with all four placeholders, translated.
- Control: a bar chart's data labels are unchanged and carry no halo. Treemap leaf names are still white and no sankey labels appear. A pie draws no halo labels.

Results on head f0a3687126 (after merging origin/main and re-running `pnpm run setup` for the moved pin):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/ packages/i18n/ --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 183 passed (183), Tests 2609 passed, 22 skipped (2631).
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-charts --filter=@object-ui/i18n` (no dependents): Tasks 11 successful, 11 total.
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors. The only warnings in new code are 7 `no-explicit-any` in the new test file, from the same `vi.mock` and `series as any` shape its sibling tests use.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations` and `check-changeset-presence`: all exit 0.

Ablation, one leg per fix. Each mutation went through the anchor-must-hit replace tool and was restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`:

- `node={SankeyNodeShape}` changed back to the old `{ fill: ... }` object: 3 failed, 10 passed (no node text, and the node-fill comparison fails).
- `link={SankeyLinkShape}` changed back to the old grey object: 2 failed, 11 passed (link strokes and caller palette).
- Funnel `LabelList` changed back to `position="right"`: 2 failed, 11 passed. "Qualification is anchored inside the plot: expected 433 to be less than 360", and the halo assertion also fails.
- `SankeyOmittedRowsNote` changed back to the old English JSX: 1 failed, 24 passed with `AdvancedChartImpl.sankeyOmittedRows.test.tsx` included. Only the zh test fails, so the en output is byte-identical to the old JSX.

## Acceptance notes

- The other footnotes and refusals in this file are still English-only JSX: `unsizedRowsNote`, `MagnitudeRefusal`, the sankey `no-positive-flow` refusal, and the axis-position and unplotted-points notes. They have the same defect but this card does not name them, so they are not changed here.
- The `en` pack is in the eager closure. This adds one three-row family to it, so the `Bundle Analysis` performance-budget check in CI is the reading for its size.
- The line/area `XAxis` that PR #13420 changed is not touched.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
